parsed.basis: Hauts-Bassins inherits Burkina Faso's national regime, under which consensual same-sex relations became a criminal offence on 1 September 2025, punishable by two to five years' imprisonment and a fine, with foreign nationals subject to deportation, and promotion of homosexuality or similar behaviour also prohibited. A transgender visitor whose relationship is read locally on the basis of sex assigned at birth would fall within those terms. The constitution's anti-discrimination clause omits sexual orientation and gender identity, and no mechanism for responding to anti-LGBT violence is documented, while religious and traditional opinion has not accepted homosexuality and societal abuse has been reported. No region-specific information distinguishes Hauts-Bassins, including Bobo-Dioulasso, from the national picture on enforcement or protection.
